about_the_game:
Let's set off with the "Whale & Sky" in June 2025!

An unheard-of Marine future city!

Welcome to the Marine future city where humans and Merfolk​ coexist - Whale Sky City!

This is a third-person shooter perspective. the game lets you become the captain of the Whale Sky Agents and fight alongside your team members!

In Whale Sky City, many marine creatures have been infected with an unknown and specific virus, harming the citizens. Use specialized firearms to free them from viral control!

Variety of novel and fun gameplay!

Embark on your life as a Whale Sky resident: work as a barista, chef, photographer… Achieve extraordinary accomplishments in your beloved field!

Fully customize your image and personality!

As the captain of the Whale Sky Agents, enter the "fantasy dimension"! Unleash your imagination to craft the image and personality you desire!

Chat with Whale Sky citizens through different choices!

Get to know everyone in Whale Sky and befriend these magical, interesting residents! Your personality will determine the choices you make during conversations!

This is a game developed by individuals.More exciting content will be added with game updates! Thank you for your support!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 or newer, 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-8350
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 580 / AMD HD 7870
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

short_description: Whale & Sky is a third-person shooter set in a futuristic ocean city. As a special agent, you arrive at the floating metropolis Whale Sky City — to hunt down a rogue swarm of virus-infected fish. Recruit elite agents, forge alliances, and eradicate the virus-infected fish menace.
